mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, mission_type AS missionType, trigger_event AS triggerEvent, target_count AS targetCount, reward_point AS rewardPoint, auto_complete AS autoComplete, created_at AS createdAt FROM mission
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (title, description, mission_type, trigger_event, target_count, reward_point, auto_complete) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{missionType}, #{triggerEvent}, #{targetCount}, #{rewardPoint}, #{autoComplete})
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, mission_type = #{missionType}, trigger_event = #{triggerEvent}, target_count = #{targetCount}, reward_point = #{rewardPoint}, auto_complete = #{autoComplete} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mission_image (mission_id, origin_name, saved_name, file_path) VALUES
(#{image.missionId}, #{image.originName}, #{image.savedName}, #{image.filePath})
INSERT INTO user_mission (user_id, mission_id, status, progress_count, target_count) SELECT #{userId}, id, 'PENDING', 0, target_count FROM mission;
mapper.select: SELECT um.user_mission_id AS userMissionId, um.user_id AS userId, um.mission_id AS missionId, um.status, um.progress_count AS progressCount, um.target_count AS targetCount, m.title, m.description, m.reward_point AS rewardPoint FROM user_mission um JOIN mission m ON um.mission_id = m.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission_post (user_mission_id, title, content, created_at) VALUES (#{userMissionId}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW())
